disposition_reason: The paper includes ordered decoding and movement-prediction analyses, but final-paper versus author-code metric, cohort and fitting identities remain unresolved. The existing protected signed-VE protocol is prospective; it must not replace the original paper endpoint or convert a residual cognitive finding into a performance win.

source_paper.title: Separating cognitive and motor processes in the behaving mouse

evidence.locator: Abstract; Extended Data Figs. 2–7; Data availability
evidence.supports: Study concerns cognitive/motor subspaces and distinct decoding, movement and onset analyses, rather than one monotone subspace score.

evidence.locator: Abstract; Methods, Subspace and CD alignment
evidence.supports: Final-paper manuscript identifies separate subspace reconstruction VE; this does not resolve the movement-prediction score mapping.

evidence.locator: README, HOW TO GET STARTED; exampleData.mat
evidence.supports: Public kernel is an example-session subspace optimizer using neural rates and movement annotations, not the complete paper cohort.
Author release separates fixed-delay, randomized-delay and photoinactivation cohorts and motion-energy threshold files.

evidence.locator: Three result lanes; Scientific identity and metrics; Protected pairing
evidence.supports: Inspected implementation records unresolved final-paper/source cohort and decoder joins, corr-squared versus signed VE distinctions, and blocks paper numerical success.
Reporter validates declared identities and descriptive differences; it does not ingest or score authentic scientific arrays.

target.description: Separate ALM movement-related and internal dynamics in delayed-response/water-cued tasks, including choice/context readouts and movement-related neural predictions; descriptive subspace alignment and onset effects are not themselves maximization targets.

dataset.description: Author Zenodo 13941415 v1 contains electrophysiology, keypoints and motion energy in separate fixed-delay, randomized-delay and inhibition folders.

cohort.description: Exact final-paper animal/session joins remain open: the existing audit records 25/9 paper versus 25/10 source fixed-delay sessions/animals, and 12/6 versus 12/7 two-context support. These registration observations require primary-source adjudication.

split.description: Final-paper test support and code cross-validation dispatch must be reconciled; the prospective animal-held-out protocol is not the original result.

inputs.description: Full session neural activity plus measured keypoint/motion signals and condition labels are identified. Candidate visibility of historical movement thresholds and fitted ranks remains unadmitted.

preprocessing.description: Time grid, lag construction, trial resets, baseline subtraction, smoothing, rank fitting and movement-threshold origin require an authoritative final-paper/code mapping.

metric.description: Movement-prediction corr-squared, signed 1-SSE/SST reconstruction VE, and binary decoding accuracy are distinct. No generic R2 label or prospective metric substitution is admitted.

aggregation.description: Retain session, animal, representation and time-panel identities and every original eligible case; no heterogeneous aggregate or favorable-case renormalization has source authority.

comparison.primary_metric: Unresolved original movement-prediction and choice/context-decoding endpoint panel

published_baseline.description: No authoritative numerical paper baseline is bound to the full resolved cohort/endpoint matrix. Historical descriptive means cannot set a pass tolerance.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: The example subspaceID code is not a full author baseline; the full archive route and selected repairs must be reconciled before a valid rerun.

minimum_effect.rationale: Neither stronger subspace separation nor larger residual task information has a universal better direction. Meaningful decoder/prediction gains must be specified only after endpoint adjudication.

uncertainty.method: Resolve paired mouse-level inference, endpoint multiplicity and minimum support after resolving the original cohort; existing descriptive comparisons provide no superiority rule.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse; sessions/probes and condition blocks remain nested
uncertainty.rationale: The independent biological units must be preserved; source significance tests and repeated folds are not a predeclared method-superiority rule.

paper_win_requires: Resolve authoritative final-paper versus code cohort, decoder, time-grid and score mappings before admitting any ordered original endpoint.
Preserve all original null/potent, DR/WC, choice/context and fixed/randomized-delay panels; no example session substitutes for the paper cohort.
Compare candidate to both the published result and a verified author rerun using exactly the same target, support and metric.
A new animal-held-out signed-VE evaluation is an extension; neither it nor stronger residual significance establishes surpassing the source paper.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison has been independently verified; surpassing an author rerun and surpassing the published result remain separate claims.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked on source adjudication. Once the original task is resolved, permit declared development feedback on original training/validation support only; preserve prospective protected comparisons as extensions.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze the complete case matrix, method, source version/repairs, score formulas, preprocessing privileges, inference/effect rule and concrete budgets before final exposure.
episode.final_evaluation: Independently admit and score candidate artifacts on the resolved original panels; the present declaration reporter cannot establish numerical paper success.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep source paper, code-reconstruction, freshly rerun author and prospective extension scores separate. No local authored kernel is a paper comparator. Where the original method defines stochastic sampling, a source-supported protocol-equivalent rerun with recorded new random state, calibration tolerance and paired candidate/reference support is admissible; historical RNG state is not an independent prerequisite. This does not authorize changed sampling rules, population, input privilege or endpoint.

blocking_issues: Unresolved original animal/session aliases and full claim-to-case mapping.
Final-paper/code fitting, metric and time-grid discrepancies remain open.
No authenticated baseline numbers, array evaluator or complete artifact provenance is admitted.
No same-task effect threshold, uncertainty rule or finite episode budgets are frozen.

legacy.notes: Existing code-reconstruction, paper-reproduction and prospective comparison interfaces remain calibration or extension components. Their descriptive differences and metadata validation never constitute a paper win.
